notes.title: Looking Ahead...
notes.content:
[h2][b]How has it been almost one year since we launched Fear Is In The Mind?[/b][/h2]

What a rollercoster it has been and thank you to everyone who has sat down and played our quirky little game! To celebrate the milestone, we feel it's only fitting we add some features to the game we did not have enough time for initially, and bring the game up to a more professional level. [b]PLUS[/b] the game is 30% off right now! Snag this deal before it's too late! 

As such we have currently in the pipeline: [list]
[*] [b]Localisation[/b] - Get in touch if you want us to localise the game into your language!
[*] [b]A free Epilogue[/b] - To sum up what happened to [REDACTED].
[*] [b]Level Select Screen[/b] - We didn't have enough time initially, so we'll add one for sure.
[*] [b]Audio Settings[/b] - This one was just Lucas' pure greed, we're sorry for his stinking attitude. (I'm not fired right?)
[*] [b]Bug Fixes[/b] - A handful of small bug fixes related to the pesky UI.
[/list]

We can't wait to show you more so make sure to follow us on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@wrong_way_games_official]Youtube[/url] and [url=https://bsky.app/profile/wwgames.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url] to stay up to date with our progress!

Oh and before we go...we have started work on something big. A shiny new project, so if you're a programmer and not too busy, get in touch with us through our email: contact@wrongwaygames.com.au

[b]Thank you![/b]

notes.title: We'll Be Chilling In The Sun
notes.content:
[h1]From everyone here at Wrong Way Games, we hope you have an amazing Christmas and New Years![/h1]

[h2]But before we close up shop for the holiday season, we wanted to quickly mention that through the winter sale, Fear Is In The Mind will be 50% off! Make sure to catch this deal before it's too late![/h2]

We will be closed from the 16th of December till the 6th of January 2025, so updates and announcements maybe quite slow. We'll still be keeping our eye on things so don't be afraid to message us on our socials or at: contact@wrongwaygames.com.au

Stay safe this holiday season, and we'll see you next year with some major announcements!

notes.title: Fear Is In The Mind...it's here!
notes.content:
[h3][b]IT'S TIME...[/b][/h3]

[h2]It's time to explore a mind that is broken. A mind so out of touch that it can't separate fact from fiction. Can you save a life before it's too late?[/h2]

And whilst you are saving a life...if you encounter any issues whilst playing the game, then feel free to reach out to us on our socials or at: contact@wrongwaygames.com.au

We will have a Discord server up and running shortly so follow us on our socials to keep up to date!
Thank you and have fun!
